doc: Helium (Kyutai): Llama whose rotary pairs are INTERLEAVED (rotate_half over even/odd lanes, cos/sin repeat_interleave'd), an o_proj without bias, rms_norm_eps 1e-8 and head_dim 128 by default. The rope pairing is class code, not configuration: no standard reading can know it. Third-party adapter (lane H): data only.
